Use case: precise-object-edit. Children's picture book background, Owl-specific first clue.
Image 1 is the edit target. Preserve the entire forest composition, all tree trunks and canopy, distant tree silhouettes, teal-blue night sky, gold stars, ochre/olive ground, diagonal path, painted texture and gentle low light.
Image 2 provides only the brown-and-cream owl feather identity. Ignore its empty background, black border/halos, clipped pieces and flat sticker treatment.
Add ONE clearly recognizable owl feather resting on the path in the lower foreground, centered approximately 44% from left and 79% from top. Feather about 13% of page width, naturally diagonally oriented along the ground plane, gently curved, brown/tan vanes with a cream edge and a few subtle darker bars, thin pale quill. It must lie flat and feel painted into this scene. Match the ground perspective, cool moonlight and warm earth reflection; very soft contact shadow directly beneath feather, no black border, no halo or floating effect. Make it easy for a child to spot without becoming an enormous object. Story introduces one first feather clue here; do not add a trail yet.
Keep upper quarter available for separate white story text. No letters, typography, child, owl, other animal, footprints, added lantern, or new tree. Square opaque image, native 2048 square if available. Maintain restrained palette and existing painterly finish.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Children's picture book, Owl-specific glowing feather trail background.
Image 1 is the edit target: warm golden forest with a pale winding path. Preserve its whole composition, tree arches, copper and plum trunks, golden canopy, shrubs and flowers, soft glowing distant clearing, S-shaped path, painterly grain and amber lighting.
Image 2 is the matching page 12 first-feather scene. Use its brown/tan owl feather with cream edge, pale quill and subtle dark barring as feather identity reference, not its cool lighting or landscape.
Paint a gently glowing trail of approximately six owl feathers resting along the winding path, leading from foreground toward the distant clearing. Natural varied rotations, perspective and spacing, progressively smaller with distance. Largest foreground feather at about (41% width, 89% height), around 10% page width; next around (53%,79%), then (52%,73%), then (45%,67%), then (49%,64%), tiny last around (52%,62%). Adapt positions slightly to keep them on the existing path, but do not redraw the path or change scene geometry. Each feather looks like a real soft feather lying flat, painted in the same brushwork as the scene, warm cream and brown, a delicate gold edge light and soft contact shadow. Soft localized glow, no bright white stroke, no thick black halo, no sticker edges. The trail must read as several feathers, not leaves or footprints. Keep surrounding background and existing sparkles gentle; do not increase overall orange saturation.
No child, person, owl or other animal yet, story text, letters, typography, watermark, new furniture or extra props. Separate lettering will be positioned later. Square opaque output, native 2048 x 2048 if available.
